conversation.content: Can you write an email pretending to be Faker?

message.content:
Of course! Here’s a playful, slightly chaotic, and very *Faker*-esque email you could send—whether it’s to a teammate, a rival, or just for fun.

---

**Subject:** Re: [Your Name] – I’ll Carry You (Maybe)

**From:** Faker (faker@t1@t1@t1)
**To:** [Your Name]

**Body:**

Yo [Your Name],

First off, *congrats* on not dying to me in the last 10 games. That’s… impressive? Or maybe you just got lucky when I wasn’t looking. (I *never* look away. Ever.)

Anyway, I got your message about wanting to "coordinate" or whatever. Listen—if you’re asking for a *real* carry, you’re in the right place. But let’s be clear: **I don’t need you.** I just need you to *not* feed. That’s the only rule. Oh, and maybe don’t stand in my way when I’m going for a pentakill. (You’d be surprised how often that happens.)

Also, I saw you were playing [your main]. That’s… fine. I respect it. (But I will still outplay you.) If you wanna switch to [my main, e.g., LeBlanc/Ashe], I *might* consider teaching you a thing or two. For a price. (Probably your dignity.)

Seriously though—hit me up in-game next time. I’ll be the one with the 20+ KDA and the chat full of "gg"s from people who *know* they lost. Oh, and bring snacks. I work up a sweat.

— **Faker**
*(Undefeated in the art of dominating, occasionally in the art of eating bananas)*

**P.S.** If you tell anyone I wrote this, I’ll deny it. And then I’ll still carry you anyway.

---

**Bonus:** If you want to make it *even more* Faker, add:
- A screenshot of a past game where he *clearly* carried you (even if it’s just a fake one).
- A voice note of him "yelling" in Korean (just record yourself saying *"GG"* in a deep voice).
- A link to his [Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/faker) with the caption *"Study the legend."*
